# Keep multi-column resume text in a readable order

## What & Why
Text operators from multi-column layouts can be extracted safely but may currently follow PDF stream order instead of the visual reading order, which can make review proposals confusing.

## Done looks like
- A bounded, local-only ordering strategy handles representative two-column text-layer fixtures.
- Review proposals and provenance remain readable without auto-saving extracted values.
- Tests use synthetic resume content only.
